description: This file defines React components and hooks related to displaying error information in a trace viewer UI, including error rendering, code frame generation, and error model management.

classes.name: CopyPromptButton
classes.description: A React component that renders a button to copy a prompt string to clipboard.

methods.name: useErrorsTabModel
methods.description: Custom hook that creates a model of errors from a TraceModel, mapping error messages to ErrorDescription objects.

methods.name: ErrorView
methods.description: React component that displays an individual error message with location and action, allowing source reveal.

methods.name: ErrorsTab
methods.description: Main React component that displays a list of errors, fetches error context, builds code frames, and provides a copy prompt.

methods.name: codeFrame
methods.description: Function that generates a code frame string highlighting the error location within source code.
